title: mmWave Radar Aware Dual-Conditioned GAN for Speech Reconstruction of Signals With Low SNR
abstract: arXiv:2602.22431v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar captures are band-limited and noisy, making for difficult reconstruction of intelligible full-bandwidth speech. In this work, we propose a two-stage speech reconstruction pipeline for mmWave using a Radar-Aware Dual-conditioned Generative Adversarial Network (RAD-GAN), which is capable of performing bandwidth extension on signals with low signal-to-noise ratios (-5 dB to -1 dB), captured through glass walls. We propose an mmWave-tailored Multi-Mel Discriminator (MMD) and a Residual Fusion Gate (RFG) to enhance the generator input to process multiple conditioning channels. The proposed two-stage pipeline involves pretraining the model on synthetically clipped clean speech and finetuning on fused mel spectrograms generated by the RFG. translated_title: 毫米波雷达感知的双条件生成对抗网络用于低信噪比信号的语音重建
translated_abstract: 毫米波雷达捕获的信号带宽受限且噪声大，这使得重建可理解的完整带宽语音变得困难。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于毫米波的两阶段语音重建流水线，采用雷达感知的双条件生成对抗网络（RAD-GAN），该网络能够在通过玻璃墙捕获的低信噪比（-5 dB至-1 dB）信号上执行带宽扩展。我们提出了一个针对毫米波定制的多梅尔频谱判别器（MMD）和一个残差融合门（RFG），以增强生成器输入，处理多个条件通道。所提出的两阶段流水线包括在合成裁剪的干净语音上预训练模型，并在由RFG生成的融合梅尔频谱图上进行微调。我们的实验表明，所提出的方法在有限数据集上训练，没有预训练模块，也没有数据增强，优于最先进的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的RAD-GAN两阶段流水线，通过定制判别器和融合门，在低信噪比毫米波信号中实现了优于现有技术的语音重建，且无需预训练或数据增强。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel RAD-GAN two-stage pipeline that achieves superior speech reconstruction from low-SNR mmWave signals via tailored discriminators and fusion gates, without pretraining or data augmentation.
